company_info.industry_info: Computer and Network Security. 1Password is a password manager and identity/access security platform providing credential management and secure access solutions for businesses and individuals.
company_info.recent_news: June 2026: 1Password acquired Apono, bringing just-in-time privileged access governance to their Unified Access platform. July 2026: Credential Broker launched in public preview. Named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for SaaS Management Platforms. Partnerships with Perplexity expanding AI security access. Strong revenue growth with ARR surpassing $400M and 180,000+ business customers.
company_info.company_culture: Remote-first company founded in 2005. Culture prioritizes collaboration, transparency, clear communication, and core values of keeping it simple, leading with honesty, and putting people first. Glassdoor rating: 3.2/5 (367 reviews), with 48% would recommend to a friend. Employees rate work-life balance 3.6/5 and culture 3.1/5. Known for demanding work, fast pace, focus on excellence, and expectation of expertise and adaptability. Emphasis on active learning and meaningful application of AI. Generous benefits including PTO, health/dental, RRSP/401k matching, equity (RSU), and volunteer days.
company_info.any_related_information: Founded in 2005 as a remote-first company. Recent secondary market funding round of $100M in November 2025. Company has clear focus on AI and agent-assisted development as core to future strategy. Travel/in-person engagement required despite remote-first model. Background checks required for successful applicants. Company uses AI/ML in recruitment screening with opt-out available. This is an existing vacancy for immediate hire.
